rule_yaml:
rules:
  - id: dubbo-npe-c1-merged
    languages:
      - java
    severity: ERROR
    message: >-
      A value that can be null is dereferenced without a null check. This is
      either the URL component field 'urlAddress', which is left null by the
      no-arg constructor chain (URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()),
      or the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() /
      getValidServiceInfo()), which returns null when no matching ServiceInfo
      exists. Guard the value with a null check before dereferencing it.
    paths:
      exclude:
        - "**/src/test/**"
        - "**/test/**"
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: |
              $T $V = urlAddress.$M(...);
              return $R($V);
          - pattern: |
              return urlAddress.$M(...);
          - pattern: getServiceInfo(...).$M(...)
          - pattern: getValidServiceInfo(...).$M(...)
          - patterns:
              - pattern-inside: |
                  $TYPE $SI = $LOOKUP(...);
                  ...
              - metavariable-regex:
                  metavariable: $LOOKUP
                  regex: "(getServiceInfo|getValidServiceInfo)$"
              - pattern: $SI.$M(...)
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... urlAddress == null ...>) {
            ...
          }
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... null == urlAddress ...>) {
            ...
          }
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... urlAddress != null ...>) {
            ...
          }
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... null != urlAddress ...>) {
            ...
          }
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... urlAddress == null ...>) return $X;
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... urlAddress != null ...>) return $X;
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: "urlAddress == null ? $A : $B"
      - pattern-not-inside: "urlAddress != null ? $B : $A"
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... $SI == null ...>) {
            ...
          }
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... null == $SI ...>) {
            ...
          }
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... $SI != null ...>) {
            ...
          }
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... null != $SI ...>) {
            ...
          }
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... $SI == null ...>) return $X;
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (<... $SI != null ...>) return $X;
          ...
      - pattern-not-inside: "null == $SI ? $A : $SI.$M(...)"
      - pattern-not-inside: "$SI == null ? $A : $SI.$M(...)"
      - pattern-not-inside: "null != $SI ? $SI.$M(...) : $A"
      - pattern-not-inside: "$SI != null ? $SI.$M(...) : $A"
      - pattern-not-inside: |
          if (...) {
            ...
          }
commonality: A nullable-by-construction value is dereferenced without a null check: either the URL component field 'urlAddress' left null by the no-arg constructor chain (URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()), or the result of the nullable service-info lookups getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo(); both must be guarded (null-check, early return, or ternary) before any method is invoked on them.
message: A value that can be null is dereferenced without a null check: the URL component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg constructor chain URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()) or the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() / getValidServiceInfo(), which returns null when no matching ServiceInfo exists). This dereference can throw a NullPointerException. Guard the value first, e.g. if (serviceInfo == null) return ...; / if (serviceInfo != null) { ... } / serviceInfo == null ? fallback : serviceInfo.method().
